cms-f0600.title: Protect each resident from all types of abuse such as physical, mental, sexual abuse, physical punishment, and neglect by anybody.
cms-f0600.category: Freedom from Abuse, Neglect, and Exploitation Deficiencies

cms-f0603.title: Protect each resident from separation (from other residents, his/her room, or confinement to his/her room).
cms-f0603.category: Freedom from Abuse, Neglect, and Exploitation Deficiencies

cms-f0919.title: Make sure that a working call system is available in each resident's  bathroom and bathing area.

cms-f0584.title: Honor the resident's right to a safe, clean, comfortable and homelike environment, including but not limited to receiving treatment and supports for daily living safely.

cms-f0657.title: Develop the complete care plan within 7 days of the comprehensive assessment; and prepared, reviewed, and revised by a team of health professionals.
cms-f0657.category: Resident Assessment and Care Planning Deficiencies

cms-f0842.title: Safeguard resident-identifiable information and/or maintain medical records on each resident that are in accordance with accepted professional standards.
cms-f0842.category: Resident Assessment and Care Planning Deficiencies

cms-f0880.title: Provide and implement an infection prevention and control program.

cms-f0760.title: Ensure that residents are free from significant medication errors.

cms-f0812.title: Procure food from sources approved or considered satisfactory and store, prepare, distribute and serve food in accordance with professional standards.

cms-f0692.title: Provide enough food/fluids to maintain a resident's health.
cms-f0692.category: Quality of Life and Care Deficiencies

cms-f0689.title: Ensure that a nursing home area is free from accident hazards and provides adequate supervision to prevent accidents.
cms-f0689.category: Quality of Life and Care Deficiencies

cms-f0677.title: Provide care and assistance to perform activities of daily living for any resident who is unable.
cms-f0677.category: Quality of Life and Care Deficiencies

cms-f0690.title: Provide appropriate care for residents who are continent or incontinent of bowel/bladder, appropriate catheter care,  and appropriate care  to prevent urinary tract infections.
cms-f0690.category: Quality of Life and Care Deficiencies

cms-f0693.title: Ensure that feeding tubes are  not used unless there is a medical reason and the resident agrees; and provide appropriate care for a resident with a feeding tube.
cms-f0693.category: Quality of Life and Care Deficiencies

cms-f0802.title: Provide sufficient support personnel to safely and effectively carry out the functions of the food and nutrition service.

cms-f0804.title: Ensure food and drink is palatable, attractive, and at a safe and appetizing temperature.

cms-k0311.title: Have an enclosure around a vertical opening shaft.

cms-k0353.title: Inspect, test, and maintain automatic sprinkler systems.

cms-k0363.title: Install corridor and hallway doors that block smoke.

cms-k0372.title: Ensure smoke barriers are constructed to a 1 hour fire resistance rating.

cms-k0711.title: Provide a written emergency evacuation plan.

cms-k0741.title: Have posted "No-smoking" signs in areas where smoking is not permitted or ashtrays provided where smoking was allowed.

cms-k0918.title: Have generator or other power source capable of supplying service within 10 seconds.
cms-k0918.category: Gas, Vacuum, and Electrical Systems Deficiencies

cms-k0211.title: Keep aisles, corridors, and exits free of obstruction in case of emergency.

cms-k0222.title: Add doors in an exit area that do not require the use of a key from the exit side unless in case of special locking arrangements.

cms-k0511.title: Have properly installed electrical wiring and gas equipment.

cms-f0636.title: Assess the resident completely in a timely manner  when first admitted, and then periodically, at least every 12 months.
cms-f0636.category: Resident Assessment and Care Planning Deficiencies

cms-f0638.title: Assure that each resident’s assessment is updated at least once every 3 months.
cms-f0638.category: Resident Assessment and Care Planning Deficiencies

cms-f0640.title: Encode each resident’s assessment data and transmit these data to the State within 7 days of assessment.
cms-f0640.category: Resident Assessment and Care Planning Deficiencies

cms-f0924.title: Put firmly secured handrails on each side of hallways.

cms-f0550.title: Honor the resident's right to a dignified existence, self-determination, communication, and to exercise his or her rights.

cms-f0580.title: Immediately tell the resident, the resident's doctor, and a family member of situations (injury/decline/room, etc.)  that affect the resident.

cms-f0685.title: Assist a resident in gaining access to vision and hearing services.
cms-f0685.category: Quality of Life and Care Deficiencies

cms-f0756.title: Ensure a licensed pharmacist perform a monthly drug regimen review, including the medical chart, following irregularity reporting guidelines in developed policies and procedures.

cms-f0758.title: Implement gradual dose reductions(GDR) and non-pharmacological interventions, unless contraindicated, prior to initiating or instead of continuing psychotropic medication; and PRN orders for psychotropic medications are only used when the medication is necessary and PRN use is limited.

cms-f0806.title: Ensure each resident receives and the facility provides food that accommodates resident allergies, intolerances, and preferences, as well as appealing options.

cms-f0790.title: Provide routine and 24-hour emergency dental care for each resident.
cms-f0790.category: Quality of Life and Care Deficiencies

cms-f0850.title: Hire a qualified full-time social worker in a facility with more than 120 beds.

cms-f0761.title: Ensure drugs and biologicals used in the facility are labeled in accordance with currently accepted professional principles; and all drugs and biologicals must be stored in locked compartments, separately locked, compartments for controlled drugs.

cms-f0684.title: Provide appropriate treatment and care according to orders, resident’s preferences and goals.
cms-f0684.category: Quality of Life and Care Deficiencies

cms-k0321.title: Ensure that special areas are constructed so that walls can resist fire for one hour or have an approved fire extinguishing system.

cms-k0345.title: Have approved installation, maintenance and testing program for fire alarm systems.

cms-k0351.title: Install an approved automatic sprinkler system.

cms-k0920.title: Ensure proper usage of power strips and extension cords.
cms-k0920.category: Gas, Vacuum, and Electrical Systems Deficiencies

cms-k0923.title: Have proper medical gas storage and administration areas.
cms-k0923.category: Gas, Vacuum, and Electrical Systems Deficiencies

cms-f0686.title: Provide appropriate pressure ulcer care and prevent new ulcers from developing.
cms-f0686.category: Quality of Life and Care Deficiencies

cms-f0725.title: Provide enough nursing staff every day to meet the needs of every resident; and have a licensed nurse in charge on each shift.

cms-f0727.title: Have a registered nurse on duty 8 hours a day; and  select a registered nurse to be the director of nurses on a full time basis.

cms-f0801.title: Employ sufficient staff with the appropriate competencies and skills sets to carry out the functions of the food and nutrition service, including a qualified dietician.

cms-f0838.title: Conduct and document a facility-wide assessment to determine what resources are necessary to care for residents competently during both day-to-day operations (including nights and weekends) and emergencies.

cms-f0868.title: Have the Quality Assessment and Assurance group have the required members and meet at least quarterly

cms-f0908.title: Keep all essential equipment working safely.

cms-f0921.title: Make sure that the nursing home area is safe, easy to use, clean and comfortable for residents, staff and the public.

cms-f0565.title: Honor the resident's right to organize and participate in resident/family groups in the facility.

cms-f0679.title: Provide activities to meet all resident's needs.
cms-f0679.category: Quality of Life and Care Deficiencies

cms-f0557.title: Honor the resident's right to be treated with respect and dignity and to retain and use personal possessions.

cms-f0561.title: Honor the resident's right to and the facility must promote and facilitate resident self-determination through support of resident choice.

cms-f0623.title: Provide timely notification to the resident, and if applicable to the resident representative and ombudsman, before transfer or discharge, including appeal rights.

cms-f0625.title: Notify the resident or the resident’s representative in writing how long the nursing home will hold the resident’s bed in cases of transfer to a hospital or therapeutic leave.

cms-f0577.title: Allow residents to easily view the nursing home's survey results and communicate with advocate agencies.

cms-f0730.title: Observe each nurse aide's job performance and give regular training.

cms-k0255.title: Ensure that suites are correctly sub-divided by noncombustible or limited-combustible construction.

cms-k0521.title: Ensure heating and ventilation systems that have been properly installed according to the manufacturer's instructions.

cms-k0914.title: Ensure receptacles at patient bed locations and where general anesthesia is administered, are tested after initial installation, replacement or servicing.
cms-k0914.category: Gas, Vacuum, and Electrical Systems Deficiencies

cms-k0325.title: Have properly installed hallway dispensers for alcohol-based hand rub.

cms-k0781.title: Have restrictions on the use of portable space heaters.

cms-f0641.title: Ensure each resident receives an accurate assessment.
cms-f0641.category: Resident Assessment and Care Planning Deficiencies

cms-f0805.title: Ensure each resident receives and the facility provides food prepared in a form designed to meet individual needs.
